zh.name: securityframeworks
zh.caption: OWASP 與 MITRE ATT&CK：互補的觀察角度
zh.description: 兩欄是平行比較；NIST SP 800-115補上測試活動的規劃、執行、證據與報告方法。ATT&CK技術編號不構成測試授權。

items.title: OWASP
items.body:
從應用程式弱點與安全控制出發
要測什麼？如何驗證與改善？

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK
items.body:
從已知攻擊者行為出發
攻擊者如何行動？防禦能否偵測？

en.name: securityframeworks
en.caption: OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK: complementary perspectives
en.description: These are parallel perspectives. NIST SP 800-115 adds assessment planning, execution, evidence and reporting. An ATT&CK identifier does not authorize a test.

items.title: OWASP
items.body:
Starts with application weaknesses and security controls
What should be tested, verified and improved?

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK
items.body:
Starts with observed adversary behavior
How do attackers act, and can defenses detect them?

zh.name: itotrisks
zh.caption: 同樣是安全測試，風險並不相同
zh.description: 產業安全要求取決於實際資產與風險，不代表所有IT或OT系統都有相同限制。兩欄比較考量，不表示OT可以忽略資料安全與服務復原。

items.title: 企業 IT 系統
items.body:
辦公網路、網站、一般應用程式
主要考量：服務可用性、資料安全、系統復原

items.title: 晶圓廠 OT 系統
items.body:
製造設備、控制系統、製程網路
額外考量：設備安全、製程穩定、實體損失

en.name: itotrisks
en.caption: Security testing carries different risks
en.description: Requirements depend on actual assets and risks, rather than imposing identical restrictions on every IT or OT system. The comparison does not imply that OT can ignore data security or recovery.

items.title: Enterprise IT systems
items.body:
Office networks, websites and general applications
Key concerns: service availability, data security and recovery

items.title: Fab OT systems
items.body:
Manufacturing equipment, control systems and process networks
Additional concerns: equipment safety, process stability and physical loss

zh.name: validationevidence
zh.caption: 從潛在弱點到可驗證的改善
zh.description: 箭頭表示驗證與改善的工作順序；受控驗證使用已授權資產與測試資料，不以增加破壞或大量取得真實資料作為證明。

items.title: 觀察到潛在弱點
items.body: 掃描、設定分析、原始碼審查

items.title: 建立可驗證假說
items.body: 在指定條件下，這個弱點是否可被利用？

items.title: 受控驗證
items.body: 使用授權資產與測試資料，採取足以確認弱點的操作

items.title: 記錄觀察與限制
items.body: 證據、影響、測試條件、未測試範圍

items.title: 修補與再次驗證
items.body: 確認弱點關閉，且正常業務沒有受到破壞

en.name: validationevidence
en.caption: From a potential weakness to verified improvement
en.description: Arrows show the assessment and remediation workflow. Controlled verification uses authorized assets and test data; greater damage or collecting real customer data is not required as proof.

items.title: Observe a potential weakness
items.body: Scanning, configuration analysis or source review

items.title: Form a testable hypothesis
items.body: Can this weakness be exploited under the specified conditions?

items.title: Perform controlled verification
items.body: Use authorized assets and test data, doing enough to confirm the weakness

items.title: Record observations and limits
items.body: Evidence, impact, test conditions and untested scope

items.title: Remediate and retest
items.body: Confirm closure while legitimate business operations remain functional

zh.name: authorizationgates
zh.caption: 安全測試的授權與風險決策
zh.description: 依NIST SP 800-115及OWASP揭露原則整理的實務模型，不是法律構成要件流程。兩個否定分支均停止；只有通過兩道條件的分支連至受控驗證與結案。

items.title: 提出測試行為
items.body: 先說明要驗證的控制與目的

items.title: 具有有效授權嗎？
items.body: 授權人、期間、測試者與資產

items.title: 否：不得作為已授權測試執行
items.body: 停止；取得適當授權後重新審查

items.title: 是：繼續審查行為與風險
items.body: 符合 Scope、ROE 與風險限制嗎？

items.title: 否：停止並申請變更授權
items.body: 此分支不連向執行或結案

items.title: 是：執行受控驗證與證據保存
items.body: 持續遵守停止條件與資料處理規則

items.title: 回報、改善、複測與結案
items.body: 記錄觀察、限制、修補與驗收證據

en.name: authorizationgates
en.caption: Authorization and risk gates for security testing
en.description: A practical model derived from NIST SP 800-115 and OWASP disclosure principles, not a legal-liability test. Both negative branches stop. Only the branch passing both gates proceeds to controlled verification and closure.

items.title: Propose a testing activity
items.body: State the control and purpose to be assessed

items.title: Is valid authorization in place?
items.body: Authorizer, validity period, tester and assets

items.title: No: do not perform it as an authorized test
items.body: Stop; obtain appropriate authorization and reassess

items.title: Yes: review the activity and risk
items.body: Does it comply with scope, ROE and risk limits?

items.title: No: stop and request an authorization change
items.body: This branch does not proceed to execution or closure

items.title: Yes: perform controlled verification and preserve evidence
items.body: Continue observing stop conditions and data-handling rules

items.title: Report, remediate, retest and close
items.body: Record observations, limits, remediation and acceptance evidence
